purpose: Source-reviewed hybrid exclusions and explicit uncertainty quarantine supplement incomplete EPA technology labels; never use target values.

volvo_b_badge_definition.finding: Volvo defines its new B-badged B4/B5/B6 powertrains as mild hybrids.
volvo_b_badge_definition.limitation: This release states that the launch was not available in the US at that time. It defines technology; it does not establish the US introduction model year.

volvo_us_s60_2022.finding: The US-specific model-year 2022 S60 Black Edition announcement distinguishes Recharge PHEV and mild-hybrid Momentum/R-Design versions.
volvo_us_s60_2022.mapping_limit: Mapping the EPA name S60 B5 AWD to this mild-hybrid gasoline powertrain also uses the manufacturer's B-badge definition.

volvo_us_xc60_2022.document: 2022 Volvo XC60 US manufacturer brochure, page 13
volvo_us_xc60_2022.finding: The manufacturer brochure states that B5/B6 48V mild-hybrid engines are introduced in the US for 2022.
volvo_us_xc60_2022.access_note: Relevant manufacturer text was available through the indexed government-hosted document. Direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; no successful local PDF inspection is claimed.

audi_us_2021_a4_a5.finding: Audi of America announces 12V MHEV for MY2021 A4/A5 four-cylinder models. The pricing table specifies 2.0L engines.

audi_us_2021_q5.finding: MY2021 Q5 2.0 TFSI receives 12V MHEV; SQ5 3.0 and plug-in Q5 are described separately.

audi_us_2021_2022_2l_tsb.finding: Audi of America bulletin identifies MY2021-2022 A4/A5/Q5 with four-cylinder 2.0 TFSI mild-hybrid engines.
audi_us_2021_2022_2l_tsb.limitation: No extrapolation to MY2020, later model years, S4/S5/SQ5 or Q3.

audi_sq_48v_tsb.finding: The 48V MHEV bulletin includes MY2020-2025 SQ7/SQ8 conditional on belt-driven starter alternator equipment.
audi_sq_48v_tsb.limitation: An equipment-conditioned service bulletin does not prove that every configuration has hybrid traction technology.

audi_sq_chassis_tsb.finding: A separate 48V battery bulletin for SQ7/SQ8 concerns Active Roll Stabilization.
audi_sq_chassis_tsb.limitation: A 48V chassis system alone is not evidence of a hybrid powertrain.

audi_sq8_parts.finding: The US manufacturer parts catalogue labels the SQ8 4.0L V8 driveline MHEV and lists MY2020-2025 among selectable years.
audi_sq8_parts.access_note: Indexed primary-source text inspected; direct retrieval was inaccessible. Parts-catalogue taxonomy does not independently certify EPA configurations.

audi_sq7_2025_parts.finding: The primary US parts page labels the 2025 SQ7 4.0L V8 driveline MHEV.
audi_sq7_2025_parts.access_note: Indexed primary-source text inspected; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Parts-catalogue taxonomy does not independently certify EPA configurations.

volvo_us_2023.finding: Volvo Car USA describes its MY2023 US lineup as hybrid or electric, with B4/B5/B6 mild-hybrid badging.

rules.rationale: US model-year and engine-specific manufacturer evidence. Do not carry this rule to 2020 or performance S/SQ models.

Conservative quarantine: blank EPA labels conflict with manufacturer MHEV catalogue labels and equipment-conditioned bulletins. These records are not asserted to be confirmed hybrids; unresolved technology is excluded from the strict non-hybrid task before splitting.

Identify the observed US catalogue's B-badged powertrain by manufacturer technology definition. This is a documented badge mapping, not a claim that every model was offered in every listed year. Original EPA labels remain unchanged.

limitations: This review corrects confirmed omissions; it is not an exhaustive independent certification of every retained vehicle's powertrain.
Start/stop, a chassis 48V battery, European availability or a manufacturer name alone do not justify hybrid exclusion.
No target, fuel-economy value, emission measurement, model error or test result is used to construct or apply these rules.
